name: SIGNAL/90
summary: Cassette-futurism UI system: emissive type on a dead-black CRT, flat axis-aligned screens, stretched Helvetica, boxed labels, engineered ornament (frames, wires, cell chains), walls of text, and state changes that snap on the 12 fps anime-frame grid. Alarms strobe at 12 Hz with a dim afterimage.

setup.svg_defs_required_for_glow: <svg width="0" height="0" style="position:absolute"><filter id="sglow" x="-3%" y="-3%" width="106%" height="106%"><feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="2.6" result="b"/><feMerge><feMergeNode in="b"/><feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/></feMerge></filter></svg>
setup.screen_container: A screen is a 16:9 box with `container-type:inline-size`; size everything inside it in cqw. For SVG screens use viewBox 0 0 1600 900 (1cqw = 16 units).

principles: It is a computer screen, not a film: flat, axis-aligned, no camera.
Light on black: colours are emissive and carry meaning.
One family, distorted: Helvetica Bold stretched horizontally, uppercase.
Everything is labelled, boxed and wired: ornament that looks engineered.
Density is texture: walls of repeated words or dump text sit behind one hero.
Nothing eases: state jumps on the anime-frame grid; alarms strobe.

must.rule: Background is --void (#050404) or a full-field signal colour (alarm red, document blue, paper). Never white UI chrome.
must.check: body/screen background resolves to a token

must.rule: All Latin UI text is font-family var(--f-helv), weight 700, UPPERCASE, and stretched via .tall/.cond/.hx/.wide (or svgT sx in SVG).
must.check: no other sans family; text-transform uppercase

must.rule: Call stretchAll(root) after inserting any .tall/.cond/.hx/.wide/.tag elements, and again after document.fonts.ready and on resize.
must.check: no visible gaps after stretched words

must.rule: Every label lives in a .tag (hairline box) or a .chain cell (key over value). Free-floating small caps text is rare.
Numbers that tick (timers, KPIs, temperatures, prices) are 7-segment: seg7() in HTML or seg() in SVG.
must.check: no counters in a text font

must.rule: All animation is quantised: use setInterval/ctx.every at AF (83.333 ms) or FR, CSS steps(), or the provided classes. Big jumps per tick (e.g. +16% per meter step).
must.check: no ease/ease-in-out/cubic-bezier, no transition on layout props

must.rule: Strobe (.strobe/.strobe-in/.strobe-inv) is reserved for critical states: fault, deny, breach, danger, outage, conflict, lockout. Use .blink for non-critical status (LIVE, REC, ANALYZING, RUNNING).
Max three signal hues per screen. Red = fault, mint = ok, amber = data, sky = secondary, phosphor = traces.
Add ornament: at least one of chamfer frame, .brk corner brackets, label tab on a rail, wires with dot terminals, leader lines, dashed bays, rulers, crosshair lattice.
Give dense screens a texture layer: .wall (repeated word, low contrast) or .dump (hex/log/binary) behind or beside the hero.
must.check: optional per screen, required for hero/alarm screens

must.rule: Respect prefers-reduced-motion (the kit disables strobe/blink) and keep a user-facing strobe toggle (body.nostrobe).
Compose asymmetrically. Heroes sit off-centre or bleed off an edge; frames have one cut corner, an open side or a tab, not four matching corners.
must.check: no screen is a centred box on a centred backdrop

must.rule: Overlap is allowed only against asymmetric framing: let digits or hero words run out past an open frame side or across a band, never just past a closed symmetric box (that reads as a bug).
must.check: every overlap crosses an open edge or a band

must.rule: Oblique is rare and belongs to 7-segment readouts: slant at most one hero seg readout per screen (.obl-seg / seg(...,ghost,-8)). Never slant titles, headings, warnings, labels, body data or mono. .obl exists for a rare one-off, not a habit.
must.check: no slanted titles or words; at most one slanted 7-seg hero

never.rule: No perspective, rotateX/Y, tilted screens, parallax, or camera push/zoom on the UI. (Diamond cells rotated 45° are glyphs, not tilt.)
No easing curves, fades, slides, springs or dissolves. Transitions between screens are hard cuts.
No rounded corners, drop-shadow cards, glassmorphism, gradients-as-decoration, or emoji/icon fonts. Cut corners (chamfer) instead of rounding.
No condensed/extended font cuts or other display faces; stretch Helvetica instead.
No strobing of full-screen fields or of non-critical info. No strobe on mint/amber nominal states.
No pure #000 or #fff fields (except --paper inverse screens and white crosshair marks on live feeds).
No hazard yellow text; hazard only in stripe pairs.
No real brands, logos, show names or characters from reference material; all copy is original.
No modal dialogs: no centred panel with a dimmed or patterned backdrop, no OK/Cancel. Verdicts are full-width bands or corner tags.

color.led_meter_ramp: cells light bottom→top: phosphor, then amber above ~60%, red above ~85%; unlit cells use dim-green/dim-amber/dim-red
color.spectrum: only for channel gauges and header wedges

roles.use: One hero word or number; may bleed off the frame.
Logs, tables, dumps, timecodes, small numbers.
Kanji stamps (承認 approve, 否定 deny, 危険 danger, 非常事態 emergency, 審議中 deliberating), usually boxed.
Ticking values. Digits, ':' and '.' supported; ghost segments at 8%.
7-segment hero readouts only (a slanted LCD). Titles and words stay upright.

typography.data_attr: data-o="c" or "r" on .tall/.cond/.wide/.hx sets the stretch origin (centre/right) for centred or right-aligned text.
typography.svg: svgT(x,y,str,size,fill,anchor,sx) draws stretched Helvetica in SVG; pass sx 0.56/0.74/0.84.

components.name: Cell chain
components.use: Metadata rows, KPIs, manifests. Cells butt together sharing borders.

components.name: Chamfer frame
components.svg: chamfer(x,y,w,h,cut,col,strokeWidth,fill) — often doubled: outer 3–4px + inner 1–1.5px inset 14–18

components.name: Label tab on rail
components.svg: tab(x,y,'TITLE',col,size) placed on a frame's top edge

components.name: Corner brackets
components.use: Framing a hero or target without a full box.

components.name: Wire + terminals
components.svg: wire('M x y H … V …',col,sw) + dot(x,y,col,r); then drawWires(root, every, 6)
components.use: Connect related boxes. Orthogonal segments only (H/V).

components.name: Leader line
components.svg: wire from bar end to a shared vertical rail, square terminal, label in mono
components.use: Tie numbers to bars; align all labels on one rail.

components.name: Diamond cell
components.use: Numbered nodes in schematics; merge nodes.

components.name: Hazard / chevron band
components.use: Top/bottom of alarm screens, kanji panel centred on the band.

components.name: LED meter
components.svg: column of rects; light count = level; colour by ramp (phosphor→amber→red); unlit = dim token

components.name: Stepped chart
components.svg: path with only H/V commands (M x0 y0 H x1 V y1 …); area = same + V base H start Z, fill at 14%

components.name: Cell field
components.svg: grid of hex or square cells flipping colour in a noisy sweep (position + random jitter), 16 cells per anime frame

components.name: Text wall
components.use: Texture behind heroes; random cells may strobe if the word is critical.

components.name: Dump
components.html: ; fill with dumpText(rows, kind) where kind 0=hex,1=log,2=binary
components.use: Ghost-in-the-shell density; scroll 3 lines per anime frame.

components.name: Crosshair lattice
components.html: grid of + marks every 12.5% × 20%; drifting × markers; corner tags

components.name: Ruler
components.svg: rulerS(x,y,w,col,n,labels) — major every 5 ticks, signed labels −n/2…+n/2

grid.note: UI state changes on AF ticks; counters/timecodes may tick every film frame. Cuts land on a 4-AF grid (333 ms): broadcast holds 8 units (2.7 s, the default); breakcore uses 2/3/4/6 units.

primitives.name: hard_cut
primitives.how: replace screen content; no transition

primitives.name: strobe
primitives.how: .strobe

primitives.name: strobe_in
primitives.how: .strobe-in

primitives.name: strobe_swap
primitives.how: .strobe-inv with --a (ink) and --b (field)

primitives.name: blink
primitives.how: .blink

primitives.name: power_on
primitives.how: .flick-on

primitives.name: stochastic_sweep
primitives.how: sort cells by position + random jitter, flip 16 per AF

primitives.name: stepped_growth
primitives.how: +16% per AF with 25% random stall

primitives.name: wire_draw
primitives.how: drawWires(root, every, 6)

primitives.name: reveal_rows
primitives.how: toggle visibility on 2 rows per AF

primitives.name: marquee
primitives.how: linear translateX(-50%) over duplicated content
primitives.timing: ~1.3 s per giant word (2.6 s per -50% loop of 4 copies); 6 s for tickers
primitives.use: the only continuous motion besides traces

primitives.name: jump_not_glide
primitives.how: markers/reticles teleport between grid positions every 5–6 AF

primitives.name: overwrite_sweep
primitives.how: replace rows top-down with red DELETED blocks, 2 rows per AF; parallel panels lag by 2 AF

primitives.name: infection_takeover
primitives.how: spreader(cols,rows,seeds).tick(n) each AF; infected cells change state colour (red → sky); panels start staggered

primitives.name: erosion
primitives.how: spreader over a cell field; eaten cells go to --void; label strobes

primitives.name: number_scramble
primitives.how: scramble(8, signed) re-rolls every 2 AF

primitives.name: assemble_in
primitives.how: reveal bars bottom-up 3 per AF per stack, stacks staggered by 3 AF; tags light up after a stack completes

primitives.name: scribble_trace
primitives.how: Lissajous base + noise polyline (≈220 pts) redrawn every AF inside a bracketed box
primitives.use: psychograph, unstable signal; pair with a strobing DANGER tag

primitives.name: spin_burst
primitives.how: glyph rotates in 45° steps for 4 AF, then hides; 2D only

primitives.name: stutter
primitives.how: hard-switch between two near-identical variants every 1–3 AF inside one screen

primitives.name: repeat_edit
primitives.how: replay the same shot back-to-back (runner: 12% in breakcore)

motion.scene_runtime: const c = ctx(); c.every(AF, fn); c.after(ms, fn); c.loop(fn, fps); c.kill() on unmount.

layout.screen: 16:9, container-type:inline-size, units in cqw (HTML) or 1600×900 viewBox (SVG). Background --void.
rules: Stack full-width bands: hazard / kanji / hero word / kanji / hazard.
Hero words may bleed off left/right edges.
Corner tags inside a 2.5cqw safe margin: object/source top-left, LIVE/REC top-right, magnification bottom-right, timecode bottom-left.
Snap geometry to a module grid; diagonals must be exact (pitch x = pitch y).
Align label columns on a shared rail; connect with leader lines.
One hero per screen on top of texture (wall/dump/grid).
Asymmetric frames: one cut corner, an open side, or a tab on a rail. Avoid four identical corners around a centred hero.
Overlap past open frame edges or across bands only (M13).
Oblique only on one hero 7-seg readout, if any (M14).
Ornament over containment: frames and brackets for engineering feel, not grouping.

patterns.alarm: red field + black hero band (.wide strobe) + corner ALERT tags (.strobe) + faint word wall
patterns.dashboard: header chain + KPI chamfer tiles with seg7 + stepped chart in framed panel with grid + side list of LED bars
patterns.schematic: double chamfer outer frame + label tabs on rails + clusters (diamonds/boxes) + orthogonal wires with dots
patterns.status_list: rows: cond name / status tag / cell strip (one rect per period) / mono %
patterns.monitor: LED columns + cell map + mono process table + stepped sparkline
patterns.terminal: left list with active row inverted (amber field, void ink) + chain header + log rows (tag sender, mono text, mono time) + boxed input with blinking block cursor
patterns.auth: word wall on one half + hero word bleeding off the left edge + code cells stepping down on a rail with leader lines + scanner in corner brackets + verdict as a full-width red band (text strobes, band does not)

default_on: glow (.glow / #sglow) — dropped below 700 px stage width
default_off_optional: rgb-split (R/B offset ≈0.07% of stage width, ≈0.9 px at 1280 px; never below 700 px wide)
vfx.note: VFX are CRT/signal artefacts applied to the screen, never camera effects.
performance: SVG filters (#sglow, #rgbsplit) are CPU-rendered in Safari and on phones; a whole-screen filter re-runs on every anime-frame update. Keep rgb-split off by default and drop both under 700 px.
Scenes are pictures: pointer-events:none and contain:strict on the screen element, so hover hit-testing and repaints stay inside it.

Promote strobing HTML text to a fixed layer (will-change:opacity, in the kit for .strobe-in and .wall>*). Adding and removing layers mid-shot re-rasterises scaleX text at a new sub-pixel offset and it jitters.
Pause screens that are off screen or in a hidden tab (IntersectionObserver + visibilitychange); kill the ctx() scope.
Long doc pages: content-visibility:auto on sections.

accessibility: Strobe/blink disabled under prefers-reduced-motion (built into signal90.css).
Strobe keeps a 42% afterimage so text stays readable.
Use real text (HTML/SVG <text>), not images, for labels.

js_api.name: stretchAll
js_api.does: wraps .tag contents in .hx and compensates scaleX width with negative margins

js_api.name: seg
js_api.sig: seg(x, y, h, str, col, ghost=true)

js_api.name: arcP
js_api.returns: path d for a ring segment

js_api.name: constants
js_api.sig: FR=41.667, AF=83.333, AMB, RED, MNT, PHO, SKY, DIMA, DIMG, DIMR; helpers R(a,b), pick(arr), pad(n,len)

js_api.name: sweepOrder
js_api.returns: items sorted for a noisy sweep

js_api.name: spreader
js_api.does: grows an infected/eroded region; indices are y*cols+x

review_checklist: Is every surface flat (no rotate/perspective except 45° diamond glyphs)?
Is all Latin text uppercase stretched Helvetica, with stretchAll() called?
Is there ornament (frame/brackets/wires/tabs/rulers) and, for heroes, a texture layer?
Do all animations tick on AF/FR with steps, no easing?
Is strobe limited to critical elements, with nostrobe + reduced-motion honoured?
Is all copy original (no references to real shows, brands or characters)?
Is the composition asymmetric, with no modal-style centred panel?
Do overlaps cross open edges or bands only?
Is oblique limited to at most one 7-seg hero readout (no slanted titles)?

sound.status: documented only. Not implemented in the kit.
sound.source: study 2 (20 s sound-designed reference): see reference notes; measured with onset, spectral-novelty and AM-rate analysis
principles: Sound is its own layer: texture tends to change at picture cuts (~30% above random), but it can hold across stutter cuts.
Pure sine/square tones, no music samples.
Chatter rides the anime-frame grid (~83–90 ms).

layers.name: bed
layers.spec: sub-bass rumble 30–120 Hz under every screen; louder on heavy screens

layers.name: pulses
layers.spec: very tonal low hits on an augmented triad: 194 / 248 / 312 / 388 Hz (≈G3 B3 D♯4 G4), plus 151 Hz (D3) and 345 Hz (F4); AM rate 3.5–8 Hz

layers.name: carrier
layers.spec: steady sines ~1.3 kHz and ~2.5 kHz (harmonic pair) under data screens

layers.name: beep_train
layers.spec: 1314 Hz beep every 90–130 ms during sweeps; 6.5 kHz dash train during stutters

layers.name: chatter
layers.spec: random-pitch blips 600–2400 Hz, low tonality, every ~90 ms

layers.name: alarm
layers.spec: pulse rate ≈11–12 Hz, aligned with the visual strobe

layers.name: static
layers.spec: broadband noise burst as a transition hit

layers.name: sequencer
layers.spec: short sine notes stepping 250–700 Hz over a bass pulse (outro / processing)

sound.editing: cuts on a 0.36 s grid (≈167 BPM eighths) in the reference; SIGNAL/90 uses the 4-AF (333 ms) cut grid
